jobs.description: We are currently seeking a motivated Forklift Driver to join a professional warehouse team in Venlo. In this role, you will be responsible for the safe and efficient movement of goods while contributing to the smooth day-to-day operations of the warehouse. What’s your job about? As a Forklift Driver, you will play an important role in the daily warehouse operations. You will also inspect incoming and outgoing shipments for accuracy and damage, help your colleagues with palletizing products when needed (approximately 10–20% of your working time), and maintain a clean and safe working environment. What skills do you have? At least 3 years of forklift driving experience A valid Forklift (Heftruck) certificate Good communication skills in English Willing to assist with general warehouse duties Able to obtain or provide a VOG (Certificate of Good Conduct) Own accommodation and reliable transportation What do you get in return? Gross hourly salary between €15.58 and €16.20, depending on your experience and qualifications Full-time position (32–40 hours per week) Fixed day shift from 09:00 to 18:00 During busy periods, you may start 1.5 hours earlier once every three weeks Travel allowance from 10 km, up to €11.50 per day Stable, long-term employment A friendly, international working environment You’ll be joining a company that truly values its people, where teamwork, safety, and personal growth come first. Here, you’re not just moving pallets — you’re helping move the world forward. If this sounds like the perfect fit for you, apply today and start your next career journey in Venlo!
